title: on-my-watch config
description: ~/.on-my-watch/config.json. The checker refuses a config that breaks this schema and says where.

site.description: Datadog site, such as datadoghq.com or datadoghq.eu.

schedule.description: When scheduled runs happen: five cron fields.

pullRequestsSchedule.description: When scheduled runs check pull requests, if not on schedule: five cron fields.

window.description: How far back each check looks: a number then m, h or d.

environments.description: Environments shown as one in Watch's filter: each group's name and the env names it covers, such as {"Production": ["Production", "Canary"]}. Queries keep their own env.

historyDays.description: How many days of runs are kept; 30 when left out.

bots.description: GitHub usernames that Hide bots hides in Pull requests, such as ["dependabot", "renovate"]; ["dependabot"] when left out.

notify.description: Desktop notifications per pane; a pane left out does not notify.

panes.description: Turns a pane off with false; a pane left out is on.

investigate.description: What Investigate does: session "new" (the default) opens a new Claude session in the same folder, "current" asks this one; skill, such as "triage", is run with the problem; prompt and problem are its templates.

prompt.description: The message Investigate sends, with {{variables}} filled in; see the README for the list. Today's message when left out.

problem.description: One line per problem, filled into {{problems}}, with {{variables}} filled in; see the README for the list. Today's line when left out.

repos.description: Each repository with its queries. A repository appears once.

repo.description: The GitHub repository as owner/name, such as acme/checkout-api.

name.description: The name shown on cards and pull requests, such as Checkout.

watch_only.description: true leaves this repository out of Pull requests entirely; its queries still run in Watch.

queries.description: Every query for the repository's services; empty to show only its pull requests. Service, env and label together appear once.

service.description: The service this query watches, as you want to see it, such as API.

label.description: What this query watches, such as Errors, Warnings or a name of your own; not the service name.

env.description: The environment the entry shows under. The query itself says which data it reads.

schedule.description: When this query is checked, five cron fields; the general schedule when left out.

query.description: The full Datadog query, run exactly as written.

compute.description: Logs and traces: count when left out, or such as percentile(@duration, 95).

reduce.description: Metrics: how points over the window become one number; avg when left out.

alert.description: Every condition given must hold. At least one.

notify.description: false keeps the entry in the pane only.

investigate.description: This query's own prompt and problem templates; each one left out uses the general investigate's.

prompt.description: The message Investigate sends, with {{variables}} filled in; see the README for the list. Today's message when left out.

problem.description: One line per problem, filled into {{problems}}, with {{variables}} filled in; see the README for the list. Today's line when left out.
